suite.red_test: Tests\Feature\FiveSmallThingsTest::test_a_selling_expense_skips_batch_cost_and_lands_on_the_tenure_selling_line - 'a SELLING expense leaked into computeBatchCost', 3270.0 instead of 0.0
suite.diagnosis: REAL DEFECT in aquaculture-core InstallCommand, exposed by today's migrate:fresh lane. On a FRESH install the app migration that flags fishing-harvest is_selling=1 runs while expense_categories is still empty, and the installer seeds the aqua categories afterwards WITHOUT the is_selling key (only the globals loop passes it; the aquaCategories insert at src/Console/InstallCommand.php:458 omits it), so fishing-harvest lands with is_selling=0 and selling expenses leak into batch cost. Yesterday's green runs used the --fast lane (kept schema, incremental migrate flagged the already-seeded row), which is why the bug surfaced only on today's fresh rebuild. Every NEW tenant provisioned from a fresh install would carry this leak. The estate and the demo are NOT affected: both databases were migrated incrementally over seeded rows and carry the flag (the estate's tenure selling line was verified live yesterday).
suite.one_line_fix_for_a_sanctioned_run: add 'is_selling' => $cat['is_selling'] ?? false to the aquaCategories insert in InstallCommand (aquaculture-core), red-to-green, commit through the core hook
suite.why_not_fixed_now: this run is console-only by the brief's own guard; aquaculture-core is vendor-symlinked into the live tenant checkout, so editing it would touch the running tenant app. The console commit does not pass through that suite and no hook was bypassed.
